caption: The drawing depicts a green parasol with an ornate design. The canopy is made of solid green fabric separated into sections by seams, and it is edged with long green fringe that hangs down from the perimeter. Attached to the edge, a green cord ends with a large tassel, also made of green thread. The parasol's handle is brown with wood texture, featuring darker carved patterns for decoration. The top of the handle has two metallic-looking silver bands separating segments. The parasol is positioned diagonally on a plain, light-colored background, and there are no additional objects in the composition.
title: Parasol
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
